errors.text_span: Основната цел е да се сравнят динамиката и нивото на развитие на електронното правителство в двете групи.
errors.evidence: The description infers the purpose of the chart ('The main goal is to compare the dynamics and level of development...'), which is an interpretation beyond simply describing what the chart shows.

errors.text_span: Единиците са безразмерни, тъй като EGDI е индекс.
errors.evidence: The description provides external information that the units are dimensionless because EGDI is an index. This information is not explicitly stated in the figure itself.
The chart contains four lines: a solid blue line for the EU, a solid orange line for BG, and two red dashed lines (trendlines).
The description incorrectly states there was a 'спад' (decrease) for the EU line in 2018. The value actually increased from 0.7556 in 2016 to 0.8015 in 2018.
The description incorrectly states that the orange line for Bulgaria (BG) is a 'пунктирана линия' (dotted/dashed line). The image clearly shows it is a solid line.
The description incorrectly states there was a 'спад' (decrease) for the BG line in 2018. The value actually increased from 0.6376 in 2016 to 0.7177 in 2018.

errors.text_span: 3. **Линия за ЕС (EU) – върху BG**: Тази линия е червена, с пунктирана линия и без маркери. Тя започва в 2012 г. със стойност 0,7483 и се увеличава до 0,8525 в 2020 г. Следващите видими стойности са: 0,7300 в 2014 г. и 0,7556 в 2016 г. След това линията се издига със спад в 2018 г. (0,8015) и достига връх в 2020 г. (0,8525).
errors.evidence: The description invents a third category named 'Линия за ЕС (EU) – върху BG' (Line for EU - on BG) that does not exist. It incorrectly describes one of the red dashed lines using this made-up label and wrongly re-assigns all the data points from the actual EU line to it, including the previously mentioned error about a 'спад' (decrease) in 2018.
The description fails to mention the existence of two red dashed lines. It only identifies one, which it misinterprets, and completely omits the second one (the lower trendline for BG).

errors.text_span: Всички линии са изобразени като непрекъснати линии
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The chart includes two dashed red lines, which are not continuous ('непрекъснати'). This also contradicts the description's own (incorrect) statements that some lines are 'пунктирана' (dotted/dashed).
